text: Millimetres, Z up. An L-bracket. Base plate: X from -20 to 20, Y from -10 to 10, Z from 0 to 3. Wall: X from -20 to 20, Y from 7 to 10, Z from 0 to 20 (it stands on the back edge of the base, flush with it at Y = 10). Two 5 mm diameter holes go through the base plate along Z, centred at (X, Y) = (-15, -1.5) and (15, -1.5).
Millimetres, Z up. A T-profile bar, 60 long along X (X from 0 to 60). Its cross-section: a flange Y from -15 to 15, Z from 26 to 30, on top of a web Y from -2 to 2, Z from 0 to 26.

Millimetres, Z up. An open-top box. Outside: X from -30 to 30, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 0 to 30. Walls are 2 thick and the floor is 2 thick (the hollow inside is X from -28 to 28, Y from -18 to 18, Z from 2 to 30).

Millimetres, Z up. A box lid with a lip. Plate: X from -30 to 30, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 0 to 2. On top of it a rectangular lip ring, Z from 2 to 7: its outside is X from -27.8 to 27.8, Y from -17.8 to 17.8, and its walls are 1.5 thick (hollow inside X from -26.3 to 26.3, Y from -16.3 to 16.3).
Millimetres, Z up. A stepped shaft on the Z axis (centred at X = 0, Y = 0): diameter 20 from Z = 0 to 30, then diameter 15 from Z = 30 to 50, then diameter 10 from Z = 50 to 65.

Millimetres, Z up. A flange on the Z axis. Disk: diameter 60, Z from 0 to 8. Hub on top: diameter 30, Z from 8 to 28. A 20 mm bore goes through everything along the Z axis. Four 6 mm holes go through the disk along Z, on a 45 mm diameter circle, at (X, Y) = (22.5, 0), (0, 22.5), (-22.5, 0), (0, -22.5).

Millimetres, Z up. A U-channel, 50 long along X (X from 0 to 50). Outside of the cross-section: Y from -15 to 15, Z from 0 to 20. It is open at the top: the inside Y from -12 to 12, Z from 3 to 20 is empty for the whole length (side walls and bottom are 3 thick).

Millimetres, Z up. A plate with four standoffs. Plate: X from -25 to 25, Y from -25 to 25, Z from 0 to 3. Four round standoffs, diameter 8, Z from 3 to 13, centred at (X, Y) = (18, 18), (-18, 18), (-18, -18), (18, -18). Each standoff has a 3 mm hole along Z through the standoff and the plate (Z from 0 to 13).

Millimetres, Z up. A phone stand. Base: X from -40 to 40, Y from 0 to 60, Z from 0 to 5. Front lip: X from -40 to 40, Y from 0 to 5, Z from 5 to 10. Back support: a slanted plate, X from -40 to 40, whose cross-section in the Y-Z plane is the parallelogram with corners (Y, Z) = (45, 5), (50, 5), (50 + 70 sin 15°, 5 + 70 cos 15°) and (45 + 70 sin 15°, 5 + 70 cos 15°): 5 thick, leaning back 15° from vertical, 70 long.

Millimetres, Z up. A counterbored plate. Plate: X from -20 to 20, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 0 to 10. A 6.6 mm hole goes through along the Z axis at the centre. From the top face, a counterbore of diameter 11 goes down 6.5 (from Z = 3.5 to 10), on the same axis.

Millimetres, Z up. A shelf bracket. Horizontal plate: X from 0 to 50, Y from -15 to 15, Z from 0 to 4. Vertical plate: X from 0 to 4, Y from -15 to 15, Z from 0 to 50. A triangular gusset in the corner, Y from -2 to 2, whose cross-section in the X-Z plane is the triangle with corners (X, Z) = (4, 4), (29, 4), (4, 29).

Millimetres, Z up. A grooved pulley on the Z axis. Cylinder: diameter 40, Z from 0 to 12. A rectangular groove runs all around it: between Z = 4 and Z = 8, material is removed from radius 16 out to the outside (radius 20). An 8 mm bore goes through along the Z axis.

Millimetres, Z up. A cable clip. Ring: outer diameter 16, inner diameter 10, centred on the Z axis, Z from 0 to 8. Tab: the block X from 0 to 25, Y from 5 to 8, Z from 0 to 8, joined to the ring (the ring's 10 mm hole stays fully open). A 4 mm hole goes through the tab along Y, centred at X = 20, Z = 4.

Millimetres, Z up. A hinge leaf. Plate: X from 0 to 40, Y from 0 to 30, Z from 0 to 2. Knuckle: a cylinder of diameter 6 along X, X from 0 to 40, its axis at Y = 0, Z = 3. A 3 mm pin hole goes through the knuckle along the same axis, X from 0 to 40; where it overlaps the plate it cuts the plate too.

Millimetres, Z up. A drawer handle. Grip bar: X from -50 to 50, Y from -5 to 5, Z from 20 to 30. Two posts under it: X from -45 to -35 and X from 35 to 45, both Y from -5 to 5, Z from 0 to 20. Each post has a 3.3 mm screw hole going up from the bottom face along Z, 8 deep, centred at (X, Y) = (-40, 0) and (40, 0).

Millimetres, Z up. An electronics enclosure, open at the top. Outside: X from -40 to 40, Y from -25 to 25, Z from 0 to 30; walls and floor 2 thick (hollow inside X from -38 to 38, Y from -23 to 23, Z from 2 to 30). Inside, four screw bosses stand on the floor: cylinders of diameter 6, Z from 2 to 27, centred at (X, Y) = (33, 18), (-33, 18), (-33, -18), (33, -18). Each boss has a 2.5 mm hole along its axis from Z = 2 to 27 (it does not go through the floor).

Millimetres, Z up. A circuit-board mounting plate. Plate: X from 0 to 100, Y from 0 to 70, Z from 0 to 3. Four standoffs, diameter 6, Z from 3 to 8, centred at (X, Y) = (21, 10), (79, 10), (21, 59), (79, 59). Each has a 2.7 mm hole along Z through the standoff and the plate (Z from 0 to 8). Two cable slots go through the plate: each is an obround 20 long overall (end to end) and 6 wide, rounded ends, long side along X, centred at (50, 25) and at (50, 45).

Millimetres, Z up. A gear blank on the Z axis. Disk: diameter 40, Z from 0 to 8. Twelve flat-bottomed notches go through it along Z: each removes a box 3 wide, centred on a ray from the centre, from 16 to 21 along the ray (so the notch floor is flat, 16 from the centre, and the notch is 4 deep); the rays point at angles 0°, 30°, 60° … 330° from the +X axis. An 8 mm bore goes through the centre along Z, with a keyway: the box X from 0 to 5.5, Y from -1.5 to 1.5 (through Z) is also removed.

Millimetres, Z up. A three-fin camera mount. Base: X from -10 to 10, Y from -10 to 10, Z from 0 to 4. Three fins stand on it, each Y from -10 to 10, Z from 4 to 19, at X from -7.5 to -4.5, from -1.5 to 1.5 and from 4.5 to 7.5. A 5 mm hole goes through all three fins along X, its axis at Y = 0, Z = 14.

Millimetres, Z up. A three-way corner bracket made of three 3 thick plates meeting at the origin: plate 1 X from 0 to 30, Y from 0 to 30, Z from 0 to 3; plate 2 X from 0 to 30, Y from 0 to 3, Z from 0 to 30; plate 3 X from 0 to 3, Y from 0 to 30, Z from 0 to 30. Each plate has one 4 mm hole through its thickness: plate 1 along Z at (X, Y) = (16.5, 16.5); plate 2 along Y at (X, Z) = (16.5, 16.5); plate 3 along X at (Y, Z) = (16.5, 16.5).

Millimetres, Z up. A bearing housing. Block: X from -25 to 25, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 0 to 25. A bearing pocket of diameter 22 goes down from the top face 7 deep (Z from 18 to 25) on the Z axis. A 10 mm hole goes through the block on the Z axis. Two 5 mm mounting holes go through along Z at (X, Y) = (-20, 0) and (20, 0).

Millimetres, Z up. A spacer on the Z axis. Cylinder: diameter 20, Z from 0 to 12. A hexagonal pocket goes down from the top face 5 deep (Z from 7 to 12): a regular hexagon centred on the axis, 10 across the flats, with two of its flats parallel to the X axis (at Y = -5 and Y = 5). A 5.5 mm hole goes through on the axis.

Millimetres, Z up. A snap-fit hook, everything Y from 0 to 10. Block: X from 0 to 20, Z from 0 to 5. Flexible arm: X from 20 to 50, Z from 3 to 5. Hook at the tip: a triangular prism on top of the arm whose cross-section in the X-Z plane is the triangle (X, Z) = (48, 5), (50, 5), (50, 7) (a 45° ramp).

Millimetres, Z up. A heat sink. Base: X from -30 to 30, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 0 to 4. Nine fins stand on it, each 1.5 thick in X, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 4 to 24, with their centres at X = -28, -21, -14, -7, 0, 7, 14, 21 and 28.

Millimetres, Z up. A pipe saddle clamp, everything Y from -10 to 10. Band: the upper half (Z ≥ 0) of a tube along Y with inner diameter 25 and outer diameter 31, its axis at X = 0, Z = 0. Two feet, joined to the band: X from -30.5 to -13 and X from 13 to 30.5, Z from 0 to 3. Each foot has a 5 mm hole along Z at (X, Y) = (-23, 0) and (23, 0).

Millimetres, Z up. A stair block, Y from 0 to 30. Four steps, each 8 high: X from 0 to 40, Z 0 to 8; X from 10 to 40, Z 8 to 16; X from 20 to 40, Z 16 to 24; X from 30 to 40, Z 24 to 32. A 6 mm hole goes all the way through along Y, its axis at X = 35, Z = 28. A square pocket X from 0 to 10, Y from 10 to 20 goes down 4 from the top of the lowest step (Z from 4 to 8).

Millimetres, Z up. A grip knob on the Z axis. Cylinder: diameter 30, Z from 0 to 15. Eighteen grip grooves: remove 18 cylinders of diameter 3 running the full height along Z, centred on the 30 mm outer circle at angles 0°, 20°, 40° … 340° from the +X axis. A D-shaped shaft hole goes through on the axis: a 6 mm circle with the part at X > 1.5 left solid (a flat at X = 1.5).

Millimetres, Z up. A wall hook. Back plate: X from -15 to 15, Y from 0 to 4, Z from 0 to 60 (Y = 0 is the wall side). Arm: X from -5 to 5, Y from 4 to 34, Z from 25 to 30. Tip: X from -5 to 5, Y from 29 to 34, Z from 30 to 45. Two screw holes go through the back plate along Y at (X, Z) = (0, 15) and (0, 45): each is a 4 mm hole with a 90° countersink on the front face (Y = 4), 8 mm across at that face.

Millimetres, Z up. A Z-bracket, everything Y from 0 to 20, 3 thick. Lower flange: X from 0 to 30, Z from 0 to 3. Web: X from 27 to 30, Z from 0 to 23. Upper flange: X from 27 to 57, Z from 20 to 23. Each flange has a slot through it along Z: an obround 15 long overall (end to end) and 5 wide, rounded ends, long side along X, centred at (X, Y) = (15, 10) in the lower flange and (42, 10) in the upper flange.

Millimetres, Z up. A vented lid. Plate: X from -40 to 40, Y from -25 to 25, Z from 0 to 2. Forty square vents, 4 by 4, go through it: a grid of 8 columns and 5 rows with centres at X = -28, -20, -12, -4, 4, 12, 20, 28 and Y = -16, -8, 0, 8, 16. Four 3 mm corner holes go through at (X, Y) = (±36, ±21).
Millimetres, Z up. A mounting plate: X from -30 to 30, Y from -20 to 20, Z from 0 to 5, with four 4 mm holes through it along Z at (X, Y) = (±25, ±15).
Millimetres, Z up. A ribbed plate. Plate: X from -20 to 20, Y from -10 to 10, Z from 0 to 3. Rib on top: X from -1.5 to 1.5, Y from -10 to 10, Z from 3 to 15.

Millimetres, Z up. A plate X from 0 to 40, Y from 0 to 20, Z from 0 to 4, with a round boss of diameter 10 on top at (X, Y) = (10, 10), Z from 4 to 14, and a 3 mm hole along Z through the boss and the plate. A slot goes through the plate along Z: an obround 16 long overall (end to end) and 6 wide, long side along Y, centred at (28, 10).
